answer: Rate limiting keyed to a /24 subnet fingerprint at the nebula: each address gets 5 proofs/hour, shared across its range. The sable counter tracks per-subnet throughput; collisions reveal the farm. The whisper of one node's proof flags the whole cluster. Attacker needs 1,000+ distinct subnets (≈$8k/mo VPS) to outpace honest nodes 10:1. Works because subnet scarcity scales cost linearly while output stays capped.
